patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layouts are frequently used, pairing large, immersive visuals or videos with concise text blocks, often with the visual element dominating the space.
A large, elegant serif font is consistently used for primary headings, providing a strong visual hierarchy and luxurious feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.

The site predominantly uses a dark charcoal or near-black background with high-contrast off-white or light beige text, accented by rich, vibrant colors derived directly from full-bleed imagery and video.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, while the hero features a full-bleed background video with a fixed or subtle parallax effect, creating depth.
Sections are visually separated by full-bleed imagery or video, often with a change in background color or texture, creating distinct immersive experiences for each content block.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that remains visible at the top of the viewport. Content sections are introduced with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they scroll into view, enhancing engagement. The hero section utilizes a full-bleed background video, possibly with a fixed background attachment or subtle parallax, to create a deep, immersive visual experience. The detected 'lottie' animation tech might be used for subtle UI elements or transitions, while 'video-hero' confirms the use of background video for impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, contrasted with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., on cards, buttons, input fields), maintaining a refined, soft edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant negative space around headings and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dark, moody full-bleed video and abstract, artistic imagery creates an immersive and almost spiritual atmosphere. The elegant, oversized serif typography for headings against the dark background gives it a luxurious, editorial feel that elevates the content beyond a typical wellness site.
